gen.th.title: ⏸ Flow account {name} is temporarily throttled by Google
gen.th.body: Google's own guard: too many submissions in a short time and the account is paused for a while. The lines below say exactly what happened this time.
gen.th.why_cool: Those {min} minutes are Orante's own cooldown (limit #{times}; starts at 20 min and doubles on repeats) — not a wait Google asked for
gen.th.why_probe: During the cooldown Orante really submits once every {min} minutes; one success clears it
gen.th.why_browser: Still generating fine in your browser? Then we are just waiting for nothing — hit \u201cTry now\u201d
gen.th.why_net: Cause: since {at}, {n} Flow accounts were limited in a row, so Orante treated it as a network-wide limit
gen.th.why_net2: Switching accounts will not help; but if the browser still works, \u201cTry now\u201d lifts this pause
gen.th.net_title: ⏸ Several Flow accounts were limited in a row — paused network-wide
gen.th.net_body: Usually one network submitting too much in a short time, so switching accounts will not help. Not sure? Try generating one clip in your own browser first.
gen.queued_held: Waiting · account held by :{port} (#{n} in line)
gen.held_toast: Account is held by another window (:{port}). Queued; it will start when free

set.hint.workspace.root: Finished videos, images and project files all go here.
set.hint.workspace.by_date: On: folder\date\version\task. Off: files sit directly under the folder above.
set.key.workspace.ask_each_batch: Ask where to save each batch
set.hint.workspace.ask_each_batch: Off: always use the folder above, no popup.
set.hint.archive.auto_on: Tasks finished longer than the days below are packed and removed so the list stays short.
set.hint.archive.auto_days: Unit: days. Higher = stay in the list longer; lower = packed sooner.
set.hint.split.flow.max_chars: Copy is cut to this length, one video per clip. Higher = fewer, longer clips; lower = more, shorter clips.
set.hint.split.flow.dur_4s_max_words: A clip at or under this word count is generated as 4 seconds. Higher = more 4s clips.
set.hint.split.flow.dur_6s_max_words: Above the 4s cap and at or under this is generated as 6 seconds.
set.hint.split.grok.max_chars_10s: A clip at or under this character count is generated as 10 seconds.
set.hint.split.grok.max_chars_15s: Above the 10s cap and at or under this is generated as 15 seconds. Higher = fewer, longer clips.
set.hint.split.grok.dur_6s_max_chars: A clip at or under this character count is generated as 6 seconds.
set.hint.ai.max_workers: Cap across every key in the pool. Higher = faster, more likely to hit rate limits.
set.hint.gemini.api_key: Get a free key at aistudio.google.com. Without it, the multimodal step cannot auto-write descriptions.
set.hint.gemini.model: Usually leave as-is. A wrong name makes requests fail.
set.hint.gemini.mode: Direct is faster. Use the hidden page if the key is locked to a referrer URL.
set.hint.gemini.concurrency: In-flight requests per key. Higher = faster, more likely to be throttled.
set.hint.flow.image_model_key: Empty = Nano Banana Pro. NARWHAL = Nano Banana 2.
set.hint.flow.allow_paid: Off by default. Turn on to pick models outside the free list — they consume Flow credits.
set.hint.flow.credit_guard: If a request shows credits were charged, pause and wait for you to confirm.
set.key.flow.human_warmup: Submit every segment via real clicks
set.hint.flow.human_warmup: On by default. Everything Orante asks Flow to generate (videos for generate / regenerate / bridges / chains, and images for expand / upscale / tail upscale / description cards) is done on the Flow web page like a person would: settings, image upload, pasting the prompt, clicking generate; at most 4 videos at once. If a step does not match, only that item fails (a screenshot goes to data/logs/flow_ui); it never falls back to the direct calls Google tends to flag. Turn off to use the old direct calls.
set.hint.expand.min_images: If the pool is smaller, expand fills up to this number. Higher = more images, longer expand.
set.hint.expand.per_round: How many images to request at once. Higher = faster, more waste if rejected.
set.hint.expand.flip_replacements: Mirror incoming images so they look less like the originals.
set.hint.expand.dup_dist: If similarity distance is below this, the image is dropped as a duplicate. Lower = keep more similar shots; higher = stricter.
set.hint.expand.no_frontal: On: expand avoids faces looking straight at camera. Review “frontal” cards are not affected.
set.key.track.hold: Hold one image for how many clips
set.hint.track.hold: Reuse the same image for this many clips before switching. Higher = slower switching.
set.hint.track.jitter: Plus or minus this many clips on the hold above, so switching is less regular.
set.hint.track.no_adjacent_repeat: On: the next clip never reuses the previous image.
set.hint.track.strip_view: When you open Arrange, the middle strip starts on the image pool or the shot sequence.
set.hint.engine.flow.mode: API is faster. Switch to page clicking if the API breaks.
set.hint.engine.flow.model: Default is the free Lite tier. Paid names need the allow-paid switch above.
set.hint.engine.flow.max_concurrent: How many videos each Flow account generates at once. Higher = faster, more likely to queue or fail.
set.hint.engine.grok.max_concurrent: How many videos each Grok account generates at once. Higher = faster, more likely to queue or fail.
set.key.engine.pack.multi_task: Run several tasks on one account
set.hint.engine.pack.multi_task: Off by default: one task per account at a time. On, tasks on the same account share that account's concurrency slots (the Flow 5 / Grok 4 cap still holds).
set.hint.engine.pack.max_tasks: Only matters when the switch above is on. 2-5; the more tasks, the fewer slots each one gets.
set.hint.engine.flow.throttle_probe_min: While an account is cooling down, Orante really submits once every N minutes; one success clears the cooldown. 0 = never probe.
set.hint.engine.flow.submit_gap_sec: The extension is clicked by a human one at a time; Orante fires several per second, which is what gets flagged as unusual activity. A few seconds between submissions costs seconds, not a 20-minute cooldown. 0 = no wait.
set.key.generate.mode: Default generate mode for new tasks
set.hint.generate.mode: Per-clip first frame / anchor+bridge / tail chain. Each task can still change this on Generate.
set.hint.ui.lang: Chinese or English. Missing English strings fall back to Chinese, never to the key name.
set.hint.ui.open_mode: Standalone window feels like an app. System browser is handy for extra tabs.
set.hint.ui.port: Change if it is taken, e.g. 9401. Restart after changing.
set.hint.ui.bench.density: Compact shows more cells; large shows detail; comfortable is in between.
set.hint.ui.float_icon: When every window is minimized, keep one always-on-top icon on screen; double-click it to bring all windows back. One icon no matter how many windows are open. On by default; untick to remove it for good.
set.hint.ui.float_icon.size: 40-256. The mouse wheel over the icon changes it too.
set.key.ui.float_icon.edge_hide: Hide floating icon at screen edge
set.hint.ui.float_icon.edge_hide: Dragged to a screen edge the icon shrinks to a sliver and slides back out on hover.
set.hint.ui.bench.zoom: 40–200. You can also change this with shortcuts on the bench. Higher = bigger cells.
set.hint.ui.current_task: Internal: the task selected in the top bar. Not meant to be edited by hand.
set.hint.suite.autosave_on_switch: On: unsaved prompt edits are written back before the switch. Off: you will be asked first.

suite.dirty_ask: The current suite “{name}” has unsaved changes. Save them?

set.hint.images.rename_on_drive: On, and only with Google login: used images get a [used] prefix on Drive. Usually leave off.
set.key.images.local_mode: How local images enter a task
set.hint.images.local_mode: Copy is the default. Move is irreversible: if the folder is your library, files vanish from it, and a second task cannot find them. Copying a couple dozen images takes a second or two — not worth the risk.
set.opt.images.local_mode.move: Move (take them out of the folder)
set.confirm.images.local_mode.move: Move is irreversible. If this folder is your library (not just this batch), the files will be gone from it, and a second task with new copy cannot find them. Copying a couple dozen images takes a second or two. Use move anyway?

set.key.split.no_copy_duration.grok: Grok default duration when no copy (sec)
set.hint.split.no_copy_duration.flow: Default seconds per segment for silent Flow tasks when duration_pref is empty. Allowed: 4/6/8.
set.hint.split.no_copy_duration.grok: Default seconds per segment for silent Grok tasks when duration_pref is empty. Allowed: 6/10/15.

gemini.switches.brick_hint: Toggle to include in the final prompt

gen.queued_pack: Queued · waiting for a free slot ({used}/{cap} in flight) · {n} ahead
review.all.tip: Show every task's clips on one page in task order, with continuous play
review.all.side: All clips of all tasks, in task-table order. Click to play/pause; with Chain on it keeps playing across tasks.
review.all.card_tip: Click to play/pause · double-click to open this task at this clip
review.all.keys_dbl: Double-click a clip: open its task
tasks.hint.duration: Per-clip duration (empty = auto: by speech rate with copy, engine default without)
setup.lang.intro: Last step: which language are your videos for? Orante will collect every prompt into one list - hand it to ChatGPT to translate, paste it back, and the descriptions, camera directions and speaking instructions all follow.
setup.lang.how: How: 1) Copy the list  2) Give it to ChatGPT - the rules are written inside  3) Paste what it returns below and hit Apply.
setup.lang.copy_note: The list already carries the instructions for ChatGPT.
setup.lang.copied: Copied {n} entries - paste them into ChatGPT
setup.lang.copy_fail: Could not copy - select the text below manually
setup.lang.paste_ph: Paste the whole thing starting at [[1]]. Two halves is fine - whatever is there gets applied.
setup.lang.later: You can redo this any time: Multimodal panel, top right, “Translate prompts…”. One click restores the originals.
prompts.lang.title: Translate prompts
prompts.lang.intro: Which language are your videos for? Orante collects every prompt into one list - hand it to ChatGPT to translate, paste it back, and descriptions, camera directions and speaking instructions all follow.
gen.chain.desc_always: New description for every tail frame
gen.ffmpeg.missing: ffmpeg not found: tail chain / anchor bridge need it to grab tail frames; a run would stall after clip 1.
gen.ffmpeg.alt: Or drop ffmpeg.exe into Orante\bin, or set its path in Settings.
gen.ffmpeg.fail: Install failed. Check the network, or drop ffmpeg.exe into Orante\bin.
set.hint.tools.ffmpeg: Empty = auto (Orante\bin → installed imageio-ffmpeg → PATH → common install spots). Put the full path to ffmpeg.exe here if it is not found.
set.hint.chain.desc_policy: Default for new tasks. Reuse = every clip uses the previous description (no Gemini call); Always = describe every new tail frame; Big change = rewrite only when the tail differs a lot. Each task can override on Generate.
set.opt.chain.desc_policy.always: New description for every tail frame
gemini.tail_tip: Tail frame grabbed by tail chain: the next clip starts from it. Description is reused from the previous clip unless you edit it here.
gen.th.why_first: The very first submit of this run was rejected — this is not about submitting too fast. Most likely one of:
gen.th.why_first_env: ① Google flags this dedicated Chrome as 'unusual' (a freshly created blank browser is the usual case). Check: open it from Accounts, generate one clip by hand there; if it works, come back and click 'Try now'.
gen.th.why_first_plan: ② The account has no unlimited-model entitlement (Google's new rule: Ultra owner only, family members excluded). Check: does the Flow model dropdown list 'Veo 3.1 - Lite [Lower Priority]'? If not, switch accounts.
regen.acc.title: Regenerate with account
regen.acc.hint: Only this regeneration uses another account; the task keeps its own. Each segment's length is mapped to the nearest length this engine supports.
regen.acc.studio_off_tip: Local model is off: enable it under Accounts → Local model
regen.acc.more: Regenerate with another account or the local model
acc.studio.note: Local MiniMax H3 (Studio Zero), no login. Use it as a task account, for regenerating, or for images Flow refuses. Pick the mode like a Flow model: fast when in a hurry, high / best for quality. Times are estimates.
gen.ctx.redo_fail_acc: Redo failed segments · pick account / local model…
gen.ctx.block_studio: Make refused segments with the local model (original image)
gen.blocked_studio_tip: Send the original image to the local Studio Zero; no image swap, same person
set.hint.engine.studio.enabled: Local MiniMax H3. When on, every regenerate button's ▾ offers "Local model", and images Flow refuses can go to it. Start D:\0_LLM\启动Studio API.bat first.
set.key.engine.studio.fallback: Send Flow-refused images to the local model
set.hint.engine.studio.fallback: When Flow refuses an image (upload refused or content policy), its unfinished segments go to the local model with the original image instead of swapping the image. Starts after the Flow round finishes.
set.hint.engine.studio.quality: Same setting as the Local model card under Accounts. Balanced 640p matches Flow clips; fast 576p is ~25% quicker; high 768p has more detail and is ~50% slower; best 768p uses 8 steps without sparse attention — best and slowest. In fast / balanced, shots with camera moves use the camera preset (640p).
set.hint.engine.studio.lock_last: Auto: static shots lock the last frame to the first (keeps the person stable); moving shots don't (locking makes the last frame jump back).
set.hint.engine.studio.max_inflight: The GPU does one at a time; 2 keeps it busy. Queue time doesn't count toward the timeout.
set.hint.engine.studio.match_flow_spec: Convert to Flow's spec after download: portrait 720×1280 / landscape 1280×720, 24fps, exact length, AAC 48k.
set.hint.engine.studio.launcher: Run this when the API is unreachable (starts ComfyUI, then the API); waits up to 90 s. Empty = D:\0_LLM\启动Studio API.bat; "off" = don't auto-start.
gen.studio_handoff_tip: Hand the queued segments to the local model now (normally automatic after the Flow round)
gen.studio_offline: Local model is not running: start D:\0_LLM\启动Studio API.bat; it will pick up within a minute
gen.studio_none: Nothing queued for the local model
acc.studio.on_ok: Local model enabled — you can pick it as a task account
acc.studio.cell_tip: Local model · {q} (change the mode under Accounts)
